page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with a 3780 GB local disk and is Premium Storage capable. It does not include any GPUs.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across compute and memory subsystems. The server achieves top-tier status in Geekbench multi-core processing and image processing workloads, alongside highly efficient prompt processing for small language models. Multi-core stress-ng tests, Passmark CPU scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression fall into the top 25% of tested hardware. Memory performance is characterized by high cached read bandwidth and strong write bandwidth for large blocks, though uncached large-block reads drop to average levels.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the D64ads_v6 offers a balanced resource profile, combining high-density dedicated compute with substantial bundled local storage. This eliminates the immediate need for external storage attachments for data-intensive operations, though the lack of a GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training. The instance is highly suited for database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
